title: Voltpilot MQTT Schedule Payload
description: Battery dispatch plan published by the cloud optimizer (services/optimization) on ems/{tenant_id}/{site_id}/{device_id}/schedule as a RETAINED QoS1 message, so a (re)connecting edge always receives the current plan immediately. This is a BINDING contract (architecture section 20 item 8). The shape deliberately adopts what the Node-RED schedule-exec flow already consumed (slot_minutes + slots[].start/battery_setpoint_kw) and adds plan metadata for traceability; the edge ignores fields it does not need.
x-failsafe: The plan is ADVISORY: the edge clamps every commanded setpoint through its local Guards (charge/discharge limits, SoC bounds, the observed §14a envelope) before any register write. When the retained schedule is missing, malformed, or stale (no fresh schedule received for 20 minutes - the edge Default-Watchdog window), or when 'now' falls outside every slot, the edge falls back to the self-consumption default (battery follows PV - load). The optimizer republishes well inside the staleness window (every 15 minutes), so the fallback only engages on a real outage.

plan_id.description: Unique id of this optimization run; keys the persisted plan (schedule hypertable) for plan-vs-actual evaluation.

generated_at.description: When the optimizer produced this plan (RFC 3339, UTC).

horizon_slots.description: Number of slots in the plan (96 = 24h at 15 min). Redundant with slots.length; carried for cheap introspection.

slot_minutes.description: Slot width in minutes. v1 always publishes 15 (the platform-wide optimization grid); the field exists so the edge never has to assume.

slots.description: Contiguous 15-min slots in ascending start order, covering at least the next 24h at publish time. The edge executes the slot whose [start, start+slot_minutes) contains 'now'.

start.description: Slot start (RFC 3339, UTC), aligned to the slot grid.

battery_setpoint_kw.description: Target mean battery power over the slot. Signed: positive = charge, negative = discharge. Advisory - the edge Guards clamp it.
